title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards and Finch Circle — Daily Tax Service Rate (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
**Rate rule.** On a refund of sales tax charged on the part a Finch Note paid on a Merchandise Purchases unit, the daily tax service rate turns on the customer's cards in the Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards program and on the tier of the customer's active membership in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program:

| Active cards held | Active Finch Circle tier | Daily tax service rate |
|---|---|---|
| a Marlowe & Finch Mastercard, Platinum Mastercard or World Elite Mastercard | Gold, Platinum, Diamond or Icon | Mastercard rate, $0.10 per day |
| a Marlowe & Finch Store Card, Store Card Plus or Store Card Elite, and no active Marlowe & Finch Mastercard of any kind | Gold, Platinum, Diamond or Icon | store-card rate, $0.05 per day |

Every part of a row must hold. A customer who meets neither row is outside this rule.

## Combinations (hypothetical holdings)

| Cards | Tier | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum Mastercard | Gold | $0.10 |
| Store Card Elite and World Elite Mastercard | Diamond | $0.10 — a Mastercard is held |
| Store Card Plus only | Icon | $0.05 |
| Store Card only | Silver | outside this rule |
| World Elite Mastercard | Member | outside this rule |
| none | Icon | outside this rule |
